blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Supreme Court (SC) Acting Chief Justice Marvic Leonen urged court justices, judges and personnel to not be complicit in corruption. He pointed out the harm that grave ethical breaches inflict on public service and equal justice. “Every act of corruption benefits the powerful or the wealthy. It weakens our ability to serve those who are poor or disempowered,” Leonen said in the Memorandum Order No. 94-2026, dated September 30, 2026. He added: “Stand for integrity. Let us serve our people well.” The memorandum, issued on Thursday directs all court justices, judges, lawyers and court personnel to report all incidents and […]...
